newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates end up at 21.50pct,rate cut seen.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates end up at 21.50pct,rate cut seen.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates closed a little higher on Tuesday amid expectations of a repo rate cut by the central bank, dealers said.
Overnight rates finished at 21.50 percent, compared to 21 percent at opening and to 20.875/21.00 at Monday's close.
"We link this (rate rise) to expectations of a repo rate cut," said Zoltan Kalman of Hypo-Bank Hungaria.
Dealers added that banks have put their money into reverse repo facilities which encouraged banks to move mostly into taking position, driving overnight rates higher.
The central bank last cut four of its five repo facilites on February 17, by 0.5 percentage point each.
